description: The chart illustrates CoLEC-R performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four training/finetuning conditions involving SFT applied on different datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model labels “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B” in left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “CoLEC-R (%)” on a linear scale with tick marks from 0 up to 80 in increments of 10 (with bars extending slightly above 80). For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown: “no SFT” (blue with diagonal hatch) is approximately 66–67 for 7B, about 70 for 13B, and about 81 for 70B; “+ SFT on D₀” (tan with horizontal hatch) is about 66–67 for 7B, about 74 for 13B, and about 82 for 70B; “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (purple with diagonal hatch) is about 80 for 7B, about 85 for 13B, and about 85 for 70B; and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid reddish-brown) is about 83–84 for 7B, about 80 for 13B, and about 83–84 for 70B. The bars are grouped by model size with consistent color/hatch encoding indicated by the legend in the lower-right, and there is no explicit sorting beyond the fixed left-to-right model order; no individual bars appear specially annotated or highlighted beyond the legend and styling.
